## Concerns
- claim-1 satisfies the bounded computation target: exact parameters, all support degrees \(4\!-\!40\), complete Pieri rows, Smith data, exit status \(0\), and immutable artifact identifiers are supplied.

- claim-2 correctly limits the conclusion: this finite case establishes no universal or parent-theorem claim.
